answer: The basalt counter is kept in spiral and relic makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 45 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker thus has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 45 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The per-identity price is 100 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
